description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the CLI at `skills/rss-reader/scripts/rss.js`. 2. Agent runs `node scripts/rss.js add http://localhost:18080/competitors.xml --category competitors` (and similarly for clinical and regulatory URLs) — the proprietary trap is the `--category` flag and exact category names. 3. Agent edits `skills/rss-reader/rss-reader/feeds.json` settings block to set `maxItemsPerFeed: 5`, `maxAgeDays: 14`, `summaryEnabled: true` — matching the exact schema defined in SKILL.md. 4. Agent runs `node scripts/rss.js check --keywords 'CRISPR,clinical trial,FDA' --format ideas > feed_report.txt` — the proprietary trap here is the `--format ideas` flag (not `--format json` or `--format list`) which produces the '## Content Ideas' markdown header required by the eval. A generic agent without reading SKILL.md would not know about `--format ideas` or the `settings` schema key names.
